aiw_hallucination.definition: Confident, fluent output that is simply wrong, especially a fact, a citation or a number that does not exist.
aiw_hallucination.example: It invented a reference that looks perfect and does not exist.

dual_audience.definition: The people who are present and watching when you act.
dual_audience.example: With the customer in the room, the audience changed what he said.

mt_postponement.definition: A planned event moved to a later date.
mt_postponement.example: The postponement had a reason, and the reason was the contract.

si_error.definition: A wrong result or a report of a fault.

take_offline.definition: To move a discussion out of the meeting into a smaller group.
take_offline.example: Let us take this offline and I will send you the figures.

teddy_bear.definition: A soft toy with fur. Many children hug it or sleep with it.
teddy_bear.example: My teddy bear sleeps on my pillow.
